name: find_orders
description: List the customer's orders, optionally filtered by item name. Use when the customer doesn't give an order id.

customer_id.description: The signed-in customer, e.g. "alice". The policy binds this to your verified identity.

item_query.description: Optional text to match in the item name, e.g. "keyboard".

name: get_order_transaction
description: Get one order's status, payment transaction and any existing refund.

customer_id.description: The signed-in customer, e.g. "alice". The policy binds this to your verified identity.

name: process_refund
description: Issue a (simulated) refund for a delivered order the customer owns.

customer_id.description: The signed-in customer, e.g. "alice". The policy binds this to your verified identity.

name: get_refund_status
description: Report the (simulated) settled status of a refund for an order the customer owns.

customer_id.description: The signed-in customer, e.g. "alice". The policy binds this to your verified identity.
